answer: An optical attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by requiring agents to authenticate through transceivers moored to a coastal jetty. Instead of letting unverified bots wander across virtual nodes, each identity must modulate laser pulses near landmarks like an indexed willow grove. Adversaries must therefore deploy scarce physical robotics per persona rather than emulating software instances. However, dense fog or occlusion can degrade optical links, erroneously rejecting legitimate agents.
